home.title: Blissy — Leading The Silk Revolution
home.description: Blissy is the best kept secret of super models, hair stylists, beauty experts and dermatologists around the world. Experience pure bliss with the Blissy ultra premium 22-Momme 6A Grade silk pillowcases, hair accessories, sleep masks and more.
home.fit: **Textile, not skincare.** Blissy sells silk pillowcases, bonnets and sleep masks, marketed on downstream hair and skin benefit. There is no formulation, no active, no application — so ingredient and routine hooks do not transfer at all. The creative job is material quality, sleep ritual and gifting. Worth keeping as a separate beauty-adjacent angle set; do not pitch it category skincare creative. Note: blissy.co redirects to uk.blissy.com.
